decisions.reason: The assessment-date refinement does not necessarily change the footer requirement, which only requires the footer to include an assessment date and is explicitly described as working well.
The assessment-date placeholder decision does not alter the independently specified vehicle-group display format.
Correcting the assessment-date field is consistent with the existing premium-design objective but does not change any of its current attributes.
The assessment-date field refinement is unrelated to the content and scannability of the front-page result explanation.
The assessment-date placeholder decision does not change the dashboard's score prominence, heading, result fields, or visibility.
At this source time the internal header is specified to contain the report name, report code, and confidentiality status, not the assessment date.
The assessment-date field refinement does not alter the final-page warning's presence, message, or visual treatment.
The assessment-date placeholder decision does not change the required RR-01 footer code.
The assessment-date placeholder decision does not change the required RR-01 internal-header code.
The assessment-date field refinement is independent of the requirement to use RR-01 consistently in report-detail identifiers.
The assessment-date field is not part of the scoring-summary table's specified fields or presentation.
The assessment-date presentation refinement does not change the number, identifiers, or selection basis of the report variants.
